entities.name: Query protein (329 aa)
observations: 329-aa sequence; estimated mass 36.47 kDa and theoretical pI 5.43.
Best-supported identity is aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase, inferred from reviewed homologs with 45.2–53.1% identity and 98.2–99.7% query coverage.
Homolog annotations indicate NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate-4-semialdehyde; EC 1.2.1.11.

Homolog annotations place the enzyme in lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthesis and report homodimeric subunits; these are transferred by homology, not experimentally confirmed for this sequence.
